answer: Each new identity must post a refundable bond that sits in a time-locked vault for 90 days, and the vault address is checked against a mirror of the bond ledger at every epoch close. Funding 200 fake identities therefore ties up 200 bonds, and any identity caught duplicating answers loses its bond, so capital drains like a glacier calving into the ocean. An honest agent posts one bond, answers once, and keeps it, so the rule costs it almost nothing.
